payload.text: ST0087 WP-05's proof: vc's shape v2 for dc's todo 53, with dc's deltas of 2026-10-26 13:46Z folded in. Nothing runs before hv's go-on. BEFORE THE SLOT: (a) An issue, filed on hv's word: `intent install` refuses after any commit past the built sha, board-only ones included. install.rs:1253-1258 compares `git rev-parse HEAD` (dev_at, line 985) with the built sha by equality, while ST0087 design.md line 24 says live project records (`intent/`) never count. The fix judges the commits between them by the dirty check's scope, or by DIRT_SCOPE (S, a bank judged in the train). Until it lands, the slot runs build all at the exact HEAD, and every node's commits stay frozen until install has published. (b) molt-vc is asked to declare INTENT_INSTALL_PREFIX="$MOLT_OPT_DIR/intent" in Molt-matts' instances/rhadamanth/vars.sh, beside UTILZ_, GTOOLS_ and MOLT_INSTALL_PREFIX, so that install and `use opt` run with no flag, as AC-05.1 reads. Failing that, --prefix with that path, and the record says the declaration is still owed. (c) design.md line 18 says the variable is "read by `install` alone", but switch.rs (lines 205 and 262) reads it for `use opt` too. The line is corrected through the attachment door, with the issue. (d) Intent.app needs no quit: the running pid 79831 is build 9053 from 7014424aa, which carries WP-03's Swift change ec266c998. THE SLOT: on rhadamanth, in the launchsvc lane, asked by dc, run from the Intent checkout inside `zsh -l -c` (which puts ~/.local/bin first), captured by plain redirection with no pty. Install publishes opt. For dev, then opt: `intent use <tree>`, both links (`ls -l ~/.local/bin/intent ~/.local/bin/intentd`), the running intentd's path, `intent --version`, and `intent doctor` with the shadow check passing. `intent use brew` must refuse (A4: the keg is unlinked and pinned); then `intent use`, the links, the version line and doctor, so that "removes nothing" is on the record. `intent use dev` back, then the links, intentd's path, the version line and doctor. AC-05.3: run from a scratch clone outside ~/Devel (`git clone --local`, detached at the tip), never a worktree and never main. `bin/devbin doctor` runs with DEVBIN_NO_UPDATE_NOTICE=1 and plain redirection, because under a TTY devbin_offer_upgrade (helpers:4203) asks "Upgrade now?" and a yes runs upgrade. `bin/devbin upgrade` runs in the clone. Each of devbin's trees, switched by `devbin use`, needs devbin-vc's word and its own slot. RECORDS: each transcript is scrubbed of other estates' names (Intent is public), attached with `intent st attach ST0087 <name>.md --from <file>`, and proved past the ingest before the commit; vc reads it against its AC before satisfying it. AFTER THE CUT: AC-05.1's brew leg (`brew unpin intent`, `brew upgrade intent`, the keg linked, `intent use brew`, the version line and doctor), which is also hv's switch back to brew, and AC-05.2 on kovacs, with brew alone.
